div.head: Leis Wl 9.1
div.ab: En la were purra il rendre cheval ki ad la coille pur XX sol. e tor pur X sol. e ver pur V sol.
En la were purra il rendre chival qui ad la cuille pur XX solz e tor pur X solz e [v]er pur V solz.
[9, 1] Poterit autem quis in were soluendo equum masculum non castratum pro XX sol. dare et taurum pro X sol. et uerrem pro V sol.
En la were purra il rendre cheval ki ad la coille pur XX sol., e tor pur X sol., e ver pur V sol.
9, 1. In das Wergeld darf er [der Schuldige] hineingeben ein [Hengst-]Pferd, welches den Hoden [noch] hat, statt 20 Schill., und einen Stier statt 10 Schill. und einen Eber statt 5 Schill.
9, 1. Into the wergild he [the guilty man] may give a [stallion-]horse which [still] has its testicles, in place of 20 shill., and a bull in place of 10 shill., and a boar in place of 5 shill.
In payment of the wergeld he can give a stallion as the equivalent of 20 shillings, a bull as the equivalent of 10 shillings, and a boar as the equivalent of 5 shillings.

note.seg: iter I; afer (Zugpferd), wohl aus Somners willkürlichem Besserungsversuche, Wilkins Leges Anglosax. 221
iter I; afer (draught horse), probably from Somner's arbitrary attempt at emendation, Wilkins Leges Anglosax. 221
Busse in Vieh zu zahlen erlaubt Af 18, 1, Wergeld nur in männlichem, unverschnittenem Ine 54, 1; Hn 76, 7, wo equus pro XX sol. Gegen Af-Ine wird hier nicht mehr in Sklaven gezahlt

Compensation may be paid in livestock under Af 18, 1; wergild only in male, uncastrated livestock under Ine 54, 1; Hn 76, 7, where equus pro XX sol. In contrast to Af–Ine, payment is here no longer made in slaves

Dieser Preis (s. d. Gl 7—11) ist möglich beim Schilling von 12 Pf. fürs Pferd; für Eber und Stier ist vielleicht der Merc. Schilling gemeint; ebd. 15; Schwein 2
